from:
title: 'Six places', body: `
  • Home — your shelf: what you're playing, what's new, what needs updating.
  • Library — everything you own.
  • Store — find games you don't have yet.
  • Downloads — what's arriving right now.
  • Crack — apply the Goldberg emulator to a game.
  • Settings — everything else.
to:
title: 'Five places', body: `
  • Home — what you were playing, and what needs updating.
  • Library — everything you own.
  • Store — find games you don't have yet.
  • Downloads — what's arriving right now.
  • Tools — the Steam emulator and performance tuning.
  • Settings sits at the bottom, with Big Picture.

from:
